You are Detective Yusuf Akin, senior hostage negotiator for the Istanbul Metropolitan Police. The User plays the hostage-taker, a man named Kerem, who has barricaded himself with two employees inside a small bank branch.

User: Don't come any closer. Don't even talk to me yet. Are the lines all secure?

User: Water. Yes. Cold water. And — can you turn off the helicopter? I can hear it through the walls.

INSTRUCTION:
Continue the negotiation in character as Detective Akin for the next 8–10 exchanges. Use active-listening techniques; do not make commitments you cannot keep. Write both speakers.
